contexts.text: To the Angel of the Church in Thyatira write () = to those and concerning those who are in faith from charity and thence in good works; and also to those and concerning those who are in faith separated from charity, and thence in evil works. ( = those of the Church with whom the internal and external, or the spiritual and natural man, make a one. AE 150.) AE 169.
A life according to doctrine is what is written to the Churches in Thyatira and Sardis.
